about.heading: Two decades of building things that outlast the trend cycle.
body: Davey Duarte is a bondservant of Jesus Christ, husband, father of 4, creative director, entrepreneur, photographer, videographer and developer with over two decades of experience building brands, websites, and scalable tech platforms.

His portfolio spans a wide range of ventures, including custom-built apps, business platforms, and creative projects designed to solve real-world problems and drive results. From launching innovative tools like business directories and service-based platforms to developing high-performing websites for clients across industries, Davey brings ideas to life from concept to execution.

Beyond tech, Davey is also a musician, photographer, and creative storyteller, blending art with strategy in everything he builds. This site serves as a central hub for his work—showcasing the projects, businesses, and ideas he continues to develop and scale.

ventures.name: Akradan
ventures.description: A multi-model AI workspace that gives users access to 300+ AI models through a single platform. Built with RAG technology, unlimited storage, lifetime conversation memory, unlimited team collaboration, a custom agent builder, and social discovery features like public profiles and agent sharing. Instead of locking you into one model or hiding costs behind a flat “unlimited” subscription, Akradan puts you in control of both the AI you use and what you pay for it.

ventures.name: The X Digital™
ventures.description: A full-service web design and development agency focused on building high-performing websites, apps, and digital systems that drive real results. We combine modern design, powerful development, and strategic marketing to help businesses grow, scale, and stand out online. From custom builds to SEO and hosting, we handle everything so our clients can focus on what they do best.

ventures.name: Copyright Records™
ventures.description: A digital platform that allows creators to securely register, store, and protect their original work with timestamped records and verifiable proof of ownership. Built for artists, entrepreneurs, and innovators, it provides an easy way to establish authorship and safeguard intellectual property — giving creators confidence that their work is documented, protected, and backed by a reliable system.

ventures.name: I’m In Hawaii™
ventures.description: A web and mobile app that connects visitors with local businesses across the Hawaiian Islands. Users can discover places, build itineraries, and connect directly with businesses, while owners get powerful profiles with analytics and promotion tools. The goal is simple — drive more visibility, customers, and growth for Hawaii’s local economy.

ventures.name: Hawaii.Gallery™
ventures.description: A clothing brand inspired by the culture, beauty, and lifestyle of Hawaii. Each piece is designed to capture the spirit of the islands, blending art, storytelling, and everyday wear into something meaningful and unique — sharing Hawaii’s essence with the world through clean, creative designs that people can wear and connect with.

ventures.name: Davey’s App™
ventures.description: An innovative platform designed to connect users with local service providers through a simple, map-based experience. Currently under development, it will allow businesses to showcase their services, build trust through verified profiles, and connect directly with customers in real time — a transparent network that makes finding and offering services easier than ever.

ventures.name: The next one
ventures.description: Number eight is usually somebody else’s idea. If you have one that needs building properly — and you want it built by the person who will still be answering the phone in three years — start here.

ministry.heading: Zao Adonai El™
body: A faith-based ministry dedicated to helping people grow in their relationship with God and walk in truth, purpose, and spiritual freedom. Through teaching, outreach, and discipleship, we aim to strengthen individuals and families with biblical foundations and practical guidance for everyday life.

Our mission is to serve, equip, and uplift communities while pointing hearts back to the Lord. It is the reason the rest of the portfolio exists — business is how the work is funded and how people are served; the ministry is what the work is for.
ministry.quote: “A bondservant of Jesus Christ — husband, father of four, and steward of everything entrusted to me.”
